title: E-commerce Test Cases — Runnable Playwright Spec
title_es: Casos de Prueba de E-commerce — Spec Playwright ejecutable
description: Self-contained Playwright spec mirroring the e-commerce suite's cart, stock and coupon cases: add/remove/qty math, zero-stock disable and SUMMER20 discount — all against inline HTML fixtures.
description_es: Spec Playwright autocontenida que refleja los casos de carrito, stock y cupones de la suite de e-commerce: matemática de agregar/quitar/cantidad, botón deshabilitado sin stock y descuento SUMMER20 — todo contra fixtures HTML inline.
